st: The robotic acceleration powered by ChatGPT and FigureAI

sec.p: Chickens coming home to roost. Tell me something: has your hairdresser also asked you about investing in NVIDIA? When finance gets discussed this widely, it's usually time to sell. Or is it?
Why? The market looks to the future and sees it very optimistically. Partly thanks to the FigureAI video below.

Reading reality. Yann LeCun, head of AI at Meta, points out: when reading, a human takes in 12 bytes/s. ChatGPT was trained on 10^13 bytes (5,000 billion words, 100,000 years' worth of days spent reading).
